---
title: "GO enrichment of top MR co-expression partners"
output: html_document
---

GO enrichment (clusterProfiler) of the top 50 MR co-expression partners of PfABP (PF3D7_1315500), run separately for
biological process (BP), molecular function (MF) and cellular component (CC).

**Input**

- `plasmo_combined_propagated.tsv`: propagated computed + curated GO annotations, wide format
- `top_coexpressed_abp_mr.tsv`: top 50 MR co-expression partners of PfABP (PF3D7_1315500; column `correlated_gene`)
- `plas_expression_matrix.tsv`: batch-corrected expression matrix

**Output**

- `GO_BP_dotplot_prop_abp_mr.png`, `GO_MF_dotplot_prop_abp_mr.png`, `GO_CC_dotplot_prop_abp_mr.png`:

```{r packages}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(GO.db)
library(tidyverse)
packageVersion("clusterProfiler")
```

## Read in the data

```{r data}
# genes to test: top 50 MR co-expression partners of PfABP
core_list <- read.delim("top_coexpressed_abp_mr.tsv")$correlated_gene
# background: every gene in the network
all_list  <- read.delim("plas_expression_matrix.tsv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>% rownames()

# propagated GO annotations, one row per gene with ";"-separated terms per ontology
prop <- read.delim("plasmo_combined_propagated.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

## Reshape GO annotations

```{r reshape}
prop_long <- prop %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "Type", values_to = "GO_ID") %>%   # one row per gene x ontology
  mutate(Type = sub(" terms", "", Type)) %>%                          # "MF terms" -> "MF"
  filter(!is.na(GO_ID), GO_ID != "") %>%                              # drop genes with no terms
  separate_rows(GO_ID, sep = ";") %>%                                 # one row per gene x term
  mutate(GO_term = Term(GO_ID))                                       # look up term names from GO.db

table(prop_long$Type)

# term-to-gene (TERM2GENE) and term-to-name (TERM2NAME) tables for each ontology
bp_t2g <- prop_long %>% filter(Type == "BP") %>% dplyr::select(GO_ID, Gene)
mf_t2g <- prop_long %>% filter(Type == "MF") %>% dplyr::select(GO_ID, Gene)
cc_t2g <- prop_long %>% filter(Type == "CC") %>% dplyr::select(GO_ID, Gene)
bp_t2n <- prop_long %>% filter(Type == "BP") %>% dplyr::select(GO_ID, GO_term)
mf_t2n <- prop_long %>% filter(Type == "MF") %>% dplyr::select(GO_ID, GO_term)
cc_t2n <- prop_long %>% filter(Type == "CC") %>% dplyr::select(GO_ID, GO_term)
```

## Enrichment

```{r enrichment}
run_enrich <- function(t2g, t2n) {
  enricher(gene          = core_list,
           universe      = all_list,      # network genes as background
           TERM2GENE     = t2g,
           TERM2NAME     = distinct(t2n), # one name per GO ID
           pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,          # BH-adjusted (enricher default)
           qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,
           minGSSize     = 10,
           maxGSSize     = 300)
}

bp <- run_enrich(bp_t2g, bp_t2n)
mf <- run_enrich(mf_t2g, mf_t2n)
cc <- run_enrich(cc_t2g, cc_t2n)
```

## Dot plots

```{r plots}
p_bp <- dotplot(bp, showCategory = 10) + ggtitle("BP")
p_mf <- dotplot(mf, showCategory = 10) + ggtitle("MF")
p_cc <- dotplot(cc, showCategory = 10) + ggtitle("CC")

ggsave("GO_BP_dotplot_prop_abp_mr.png", plot = p_bp, width = 20, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
ggsave("GO_MF_dotplot_prop_abp_mr.png", plot = p_mf, width = 20, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
ggsave("GO_CC_dotplot_prop_abp_mr.png", plot = p_cc, width = 20, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
```
